description:
“Did you say you’re twenty?” 

At the forced matchmaking meeting arranged by her stepfather, the Prosecutor General, newly minted college freshman Arin found herself facing a man whose face looked even younger than her own age. 

“Student. Do you even know that I’m thirty-two?” A sigh escaped Kang Jin-wook’s lips. 

Arin couldn't bear to meet his expression, which was filled with mockery. “Yes. I heard it from my father.” 

“And yet you crawled your way to this seat, willing to marry me?” At Kang Jin-wook’s prickly question, Arin bit her lip hard. 

*** 

“It’s so funny.” Kang Jin-wook grabbed Arin's chin as she was lying flat on her back. “My head thinks I’m pathetic, wondering what the hell I’m doing with this kid. But down below, it’s going crazy for you.” 

“M-Managing Director……” Arin called out to him in a trembling voice. 

However, as if he couldn’t hear her voice at all, he lowered his head and swallowed her lips.
